abstract: The goal of this paper is to start proving the Brou\'e--Digne--Michel conjectures concerning the cohomology of Deligne--Lusztig varieties attached to roots of the full twist. The main result establishes that the $\mathrm{Ext}$-algebras of the cohomology complexes attached to roots of the full twist are concentrated in degree $0$. The main idea is to reduce the problem to a calculation in the Hecke category. The resulting argument is essentially topological and applies to all realizations of the Hecke category.
hook: A step toward the Broue-Digne-Michel conjectures: the relevant Ext-algebras live in degree 0
summary: The paper proves that Ext-algebras of cohomology complexes of Deligne-Lusztig varieties, attached to roots of the full twist, are concentrated in degree 0. The proof reduces the question to a calculation in the Hecke category and is essentially topological. It settles only the first part of the conjectures, not the whole program.
title: On the Brou\'e--Digne--Michel conjectures: disjointness of the cohomology groups
